# Echidna Wars DX

## Where is the options page? / Why don't I see this on the website?

Because this APWorld is not part of the main Archipelago repo, you will have to install it in the Archipelago launcher as a "custom world", and use the "Options Creator" component.
You can still use the Archipelago website to host the multiworld.

See the [Setup Instructions](./setup_en.md) for how to install this APWorld.

## What does randomization do to this game?

Stages and characters are locked at the start, except for one of each, and have to be found in the multiworld. There is also an option to do the same for difficulties.
Each stage * character (and * difficulty if that option is enabled) is its own check when cleared.

There's also the option to make certain gauntlets (enemy waves) give items when defeated. When that option is enabled, the gauntlets you need to clear are:

- Stage 1-1, Hidden lamia area
- Stage 1-2, Fall down into the pit with spiders
- Stage 2-1, The hole in the ground
- Stage 2-2, Gauntlet before left 1-Up (just hug the left side of the map)
- Stage 2-2, Gauntlet before right 1-Up (just hug right side)
- Stage 3-1, Right cybele cave
- Stage 3-1, Left cybele cave
- Stage 3-2, Jump up the platforms where you fight the first lizard elites.

These checks can only be done once, they are not per character/stage/difficulty like stage clears are.

There is also the option to take away each character's specials (sp using moves) and make it an item in the multiworld. The character specials are logically required for the Stage 3 checks.

Because this mod is based on the Project EverDriven overhaul mod, each character has a few "passive abilities." You can choose to start with them, lock them from the start and make them items, or not play with them at all. You can see what all the passives do in the EverDriven readme .txt.

If you don't want to have to play a certain character, or a certain difficulty, there are options to remove them from the randomizer. By default, Puki (easiest difficulty) and Chaos (hardest difficulty) are blacklisted. 

When picking your items, be mindful of the number of checks (non-blacklisted characters * 3 stages. * non-blacklisted difficulties if playing with difficulty checks, +8 if gauntlet checks are enabled) vs the number of progression items (non-blacklisted characters - 1 starting character, + 1 special * characters if playing with unlockable specials). You will get fill errors if the number of progression items is greater than the amount of checks. HP/SP upgrades will be removed automatically to make room, and filler items (Clothes, 1-Ups, traps) will be added if there are more checks than items.

## What items are available?

Besides those mentioned above, there are HP upgrades and SP upgrades (+10 each), Clothes, 1-Ups, and some traps if you set the trap chance above 0.

## How do I win?

There's an option for this. You can choose "Full" (all stages/characters, and difficulties if playing with them), "Stage 3 All Difficulties" (same but only Stage 3 is needed), "All Stages Max Difficulty" (only highest unlockable difficulty needed), and "Stage 3 Max Difficulty" (only stage 3, and only highest unlockable difficulty).

You can use the command `/goal` if you forgot what goal you set.

## Unique Local Commands
The following commands are only available when using the Echidna Wars DX Text Client.

- `/ewdx` Display the status of the connection to the game mod.
- `/goal` Display the goal, i.e what you need to do to beat the game and release all remaining items.
